name: 80014 · Aurora, CO
findings: ZIP 80014 (Aurora) has 220 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 93 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80014 (Aurora) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80014 (Aurora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 93 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
